title: Getting started with Setting Up Selective Sync

question.author: member_197
question.body: I am setting up CloudBox and want to understand setting up selective sync. What does the current documentation say?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Selective Sync documentation says: Open the desktop client's Preferences, go to the Sync tab, and choose Selective Sync. Uncheck the folders you want to keep cloud-only, then confirm. The local copies are removed from disk and the folder appears with a cloud-only badge. To bring a folder back, simply check it again — its contents re-download automatically. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
